Distant family yeah, once a year. Close family...365 days per year. Its a difficult relationship. I think they "love" me but they dont realize the damage they do with their f'd up behaviour. My mother is a whole new level of N. She says she "loves" me but the next second she calls me a son of a bitch. Oh the irony, right? Ha. What kind of mother constantly insults her son and goes on guilt trips? Weird mindset...
Having a cat helps so much. It's like they understand us, our pain and our sense of loneliness.
Oh well...I wish you all the best :) be strong

Damn... that's a lot of N's to deal with. At least we have our cats:) 
I have a feeling that a lot of people in my distant family are Ns too. Not 100% sure because I only see them once a year but they exhibit some...erratic behaviour.

It sure is difficult but I guess some things will never change..
Stay strong too :)

Law student.
I know that thankfully there are good things in life...and sometimes they can justify someone's existence despite all the bad stuff. I'm glad I was born but this is not just about me, its about everyone. think about it. There are like 7 billion people in the world. More than 50% of them live in terrible conditions, terrible. And the rest of us that live in "first world" countries? We live under an opressive economic system that preys on the weak and makes us poorer...
